title: What do swimming tags do to a marine bird? On a copy of the trial fort (tropical ocean): three albatrosses and three puffins placed; their raws untouched, given AQUATIC_UNDERSWIM, or given CAN_BREATHE_WATER; every 500 ticks, whether each bird is in water, over water, or on dry land.
fork: Whether a runtime raw write can make a marine bird spend time in the water (the user's question on Q1).

predictions.model: a flag changes where they spend their time
predictions.expects: more 'in' samples under UNDERSWIM or BREATHE than untouched
the same in/over/dry shares in all three arms

kill_criterion: the 'in water' share within 5 points across the arms in both replicate pairs
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save
a replicate whose birds were not placed is vacuous

arms.name: untouched
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); cfg.enabled=false; cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.disableSched(); print('x6: tool disarmed')
for _,t in ipairs({'BIRD_ALBATROSS','BIRD_PUFFIN'}) do local ok,out=pcall(dfhack.run_command_silent,'seasonal-wildlife','place',t,'3','land'); print('x6 place: '..(out or ''):gsub('\n',' ')) end

do: local o={}; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do local cr=df.creature_raw.find(u.race); local t=cr and cr.creature_id; if (t=='BIRD_ALBATROSS' or t=='BIRD_PUFFIN') and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and dfhack.units.isActive(u) then local d=dfhack.maps.getTileFlags(u.pos); local below=dfhack.maps.getTileFlags(xyz2pos(u.pos.x,u.pos.y,u.pos.z-1)); local st=(d and d.flow_size>=4) and 'in' or ((below and below.flow_size>=4) and 'over' or 'dry'); o[#o+1]=t..'#'..u.id..'='..st end end; print('x6 sample: '..table.concat(o,' '))

arms.name: underswim
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); cfg.enabled=false; cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.disableSched(); print('x6: tool disarmed')

local n=0; for _,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if cr.creature_id=='BIRD_ALBATROSS' or cr.creature_id=='BIRD_PUFFIN' then for _,c in ipairs(cr.caste) do c.flags.AQUATIC_UNDERSWIM=true; n=n+1 end end end; print('x6: AQUATIC_UNDERSWIM on '..n..' castes')
